title: Hearty Brazilian Date Skewers
description: Fatty and pillowy, these cozy Brazilian date skewers are a delicious kosher friendly treat, served on a lazy susan spinner for easy access.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bacon slices in half and wrap each date with a piece of bacon, securing with a toothpick if needed.
In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto the bacon wrapped dates.
Thread the dates onto skewers, leaving a small space between each date.
Brush the olive oil onto the grill to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the bacon is crispy and golden brown.
Serve the skewers on a lazy susan spinner and enjoy.
